messages:
clare: Quick PR heads-up: Im adding a compact function-calling example that shows a tool success, a null result, and an error path. Need link checks and a tiny SDK hint.

hugo: pls include a one-line JSON Schema and a 1-line eval case so QA can auto-verify.

clare: proposed example (super compact):
```
User: \"Get price for SKU 88\"\nAssistant -> call price_lookup(sku=88)
Tool returns: {\"price_cents\":1999,\"currency\":\"USD\"}
Assistant final: {\"price_display\":\"$19.99\"}
```

rachel: add two edge cases: tool returns {\"price_cents\":null} and tool errors (timeout). Show short shim guidance: coerce null -> friendly message, retry on timeout.

hugo: compact JSON Schema suggestion: {\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"price_cents\":{\"type\":[\"integer\",\"null\"]},\"currency\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"currency\"]} and a one-liner about null meaning unknown price.

clare: SDK hints (JS + Py one-liners) will be included; note to avoid wording that says the runtime enforces schema - parsing is client-side.

docbot: docs-ci: \"staging build started for PR #3490\"

sam: reminder: use canonical links (docs/schema-best-practices, docs/tool-fallbacks) and run ./scripts/sanitize-snippets.sh before pushing.

clare: added anchor and link refs, sanitized snippets, squashed commits (example/schema/sdk/links). Pushed.

docbot: docs-ci: \"staging build passed (lint + linkcheck) for PR #3490\"

rachel: quick nit: reword guardrails sentence to \"docs recommend validating structured output on the client side.\"

clare: done, merged. Follow-up: expand examples into a runbook and include canonical shim functions. Thanks all :rocket:
